import math

# Double-check the calculation
factorial_34 = math.factorial(34)
print(f"34! = {factorial_34}")

# Verify digit sum manually
digits = [int(d) for d in str(factorial_34)]
print(f"Individual digits: {digits}")
print(f"Number of digits: {len(digits)}")

digit_sum = sum(digits)
print(f"\nSum of all digits: {digit_sum}")

# Verify by adding them one more time
verification_sum = 0
for digit in str(factorial_34):
